description: This source file defines a Java annotation interface (@JsonParsableCommand) used to mark classes as deserializable commands from JSON objects within the Eclipse Ditto project. It includes metadata such as command name, type prefix, and the method used for deserialization.

classes.name: JsonParsableCommand
classes.description: An annotation interface used to specify how a class can be deserialized from JSON input, including command name, type prefix, and deserialization method.

methods.name: name
methods.description: Returns the name of the command.

methods.name: typePrefix
methods.description: Returns the type prefix of the command.

methods.name: method
methods.description: Returns the name of the method used to deserialize the command from JSON.
